metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the clearing of the Cross Keys, the door of the Theatre, the ink boiled in the kitchen, and the nine lines set for Wednesday.

yesterday: The yard-money is paid, thirteen and four, and the cart was eightpence.
You did not measure the stage for Nick.
Kemp's nine lines are still in your own hand. They go into the book on Wednesday.
The ink is the old receipt. The Saturday horn stays at the twopence already paid.
